scripts.r:
# ============================================================
# Socrata dataset 24uj-dj8v (data.edmonton.ca)
# Purpose: Fetch the data behind MapleStats MCP's socrata_query_dataset_rows
#          (exact: SODA query rebuilt from the tool's arguments)
# Inputs:  https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5
# Outputs: data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv; the prepared table as `data`
# ============================================================

# 0. Setup ----

library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(readr)
library(stringr)

dir.create("data/raw", recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1. Read inputs ----

download.file("https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5", "data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv", mode = "wb")

data <- read_delim("data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv", delim = ",", show_col_types = FALSE)

# 2. Check inputs ----

stopifnot("https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5 returned no rows" = nrow(data) > 0)

# 3. Prepare data ----

data <- data |>
  clean_names()

# Standard cleaning: trimmed text, empty strings as missing, and numbers
# stored as text converted to numbers.

data <- data |>
  mutate(across(where(is.character), \(x) na_if(str_trim(x), ""))) |>
  type_convert()
scripts.python:
# ============================================================
# Socrata dataset 24uj-dj8v (data.edmonton.ca)
# Purpose: Fetch the data behind MapleStats MCP's socrata_query_dataset_rows
#          (exact: SODA query rebuilt from the tool's arguments)
# Inputs:  https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5
# Outputs: data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv; the prepared table as `data`
# ============================================================

# %% 0. Setup

import re
import unicodedata
from pathlib import Path

import httpx
import polars as pl

RAW_DIR = Path("data/raw")
RAW_DIR.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
raw_path = RAW_DIR / "24uj-dj8v.csv"

# %% 1. Read inputs

with httpx.Client(
    http2=True,
    follow_redirects=True,
    timeout=300,
    headers={"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; research script)"},
) as client:
    response = client.get('https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5')
response.raise_for_status()
raw_path.write_bytes(response.content)

data = pl.read_csv(raw_path, separator=',', infer_schema_length=100_000)

# %% 2. Check inputs

assert data.height > 0, "https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5 returned no rows"

# %% 3. Prepare data

# Standard cleaning: snake_case names without accents (PÉRIODE -> periode,
# referenceNumber -> reference_number, as janitor does in R), trimmed text,
# empty strings as missing.

data = data.rename(
    {
        column: re.sub(
            r"[^0-9a-z]+",
            "_",
            re.sub(
                r"([a-z0-9])([A-Z])",
                r"\1_\2",
                unicodedata.normalize("NFKD", column).encode("ascii", "ignore").decode(),
            ).lower(),
        ).strip("_")
        for column in data.columns
    }
)
data = data.with_columns(pl.col(pl.Utf8).str.strip_chars().replace("", None))
scripts.stata:
* ============================================================
* Socrata dataset 24uj-dj8v (data.edmonton.ca)
* Purpose: Fetch the data behind MapleStats MCP's socrata_query_dataset_rows
*          (exact: SODA query rebuilt from the tool's arguments)
* Inputs:  https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5
* Outputs: data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv; the prepared table as `data`
* ============================================================

version 18
clear all
set more off

* 0. Setup

capture mkdir "logs"
capture log close
log using "logs/socrata_query_dataset_rows.log", replace
capture mkdir "data"
capture mkdir "data/raw"

* 1. Read inputs

copy "https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5" "data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv", replace
import delimited "data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv", clear varnames(1) encoding("utf-8")

* 2. Check inputs

assert _N > 0

* 3. Prepare data

* Standard cleaning: lower-case names, trimmed text, and numbers stored as
* text converted (destring leaves genuinely non-numeric text alone).

rename *, lower
quietly ds, has(type string)
local text_vars `r(varlist)'
foreach var of local text_vars {
    replace `var' = strtrim(`var')
}
destring, replace

log close
scripts.julia:
# ============================================================
# Socrata dataset 24uj-dj8v (data.edmonton.ca)
# Purpose: Fetch the data behind MapleStats MCP's socrata_query_dataset_rows
#          (exact: SODA query rebuilt from the tool's arguments)
# Inputs:  https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5
# Outputs: data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv; the prepared table as `data`
# ============================================================

# 0. Setup

using Downloads
using TidierData
using TidierFiles

mkpath("data/raw")

# 1. Read inputs

Downloads.download("https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5", "data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv")
data = read_csv("data/raw/24uj-dj8v.csv")

# 2. Check inputs

@assert nrow(data) > 0 "https://data.edmonton.ca/resource/24uj-dj8v.csv?%24select=issue_date%2C+job_description%2C+neighbourhood%2C+construction_value&%24where=year+%3D+2026+AND+construction_value+IS+NOT+NULL&%24order=construction_value+DESC&%24limit=5 returned no rows"

# 3. Prepare data

# Standard cleaning: snake_case names, trimmed text, empty strings as missing.

data = @chain data begin
    @clean_names
end
data = mapcols(
    col -> eltype(col) <: Union{Missing, AbstractString} ?
        [ismissing(x) || isempty(strip(x)) ? missing : strip(x) for x in col] : col,
    data,
)

script_notes: Remove $limit to download every row (SODA's default page is 1,000 rows).
